title: Asian Para Games: PH pair bags breakthrough table tennis silver

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Lhey Manginsay and Wilfred Redulla captured silver in mixed doubles Class XD17 on Thursday, giving the Philippines its first table tennis medal at the Aichi-Nagoya 2026 Asian Para Games in eight years. Manginsay and Redulla fell to Chinese pair Zhao Shuai, a Paralympic champion, and Xiong Guiyan, an Asian Para Games silver medalist, 7-11, 11-9, 4-11, 6-11 in the final at Sky Hall Toyota. The medal was the Philippines’ first in table tennis since the late Josephine Medina won silver at the Jakarta edition eight years ago.
